header.name: Daniel Peters
header.role: UX & Product Design Consultant | Certified Scrum Master
header.summary: I'm a Product Designer and Certified Scrum Master. That combination is rare, and it's what lets me bridge Design and Engineering without losing either side. I turn complex requirements into structured, shippable product. Teams move faster. The right thing gets built.
header.coreRoles: Product Design · Agile Delivery · Design Strategy

experience.title: Product Design Consultant & Agile Lead
bullets: Led product design and sprint ceremonies across multiple parallel projects. Primary role as embedded Scrum-driven Product Designer on a long-running enterprise engagement.
Mapped and restructured complex client-facing and internal processes. Turned fragmented workflows into lean, buildable structures that teams could actually use.
Served as Motion Design Lead on a second project track. Owned the full motion output end to end.
Designed and built web presences including HTML embeds across a third project stream.

experience.title: Senior UX/UI Product Designer
bullets: Design performance marketing assets, motion design, and brand identities for early-stage clients.
Run end-to-end UX work: user testing, feature design, prototyping, and iteration cycles.
Developed an outreach concept and designed infographic content for a UK market campaign.

experience.title: Co-Founder & Operations Lead
bullets: Co-founded and grew a cultural event to 3,000+ attendees. Managed logistics, vendors, and a full ops team.
Owned every digital and physical touchpoint. Structured experience from first ticket to last act.

experience.title: UX Design Associate
bullets: Turned qualitative user research into concrete UX requirements and screen concepts for a sensitive health application.
